title: Robust Deep FOSLS for Transmission Problems
summary: This work presents a robust, energy-based deep learning framework for solving transmission problems in heterogeneous media, including cases with discontinuous material scenarios. We introduce a weighted First-Order System Least-Squares (FOSLS) formulation involving an energy-norm Poincaré constant and prove its equivalence to a natural energy norm of the underlying equations, with constants independent of material parameters.
